hints.title: Ambiguous Removal Location Obstacle
hints.text: Removing brackets greedily without considering future matches can destroy valid pairs. How can recording the exact positions of unmatched opening and closing symbols allow filtering out invalid characters in a single pass?

hints.title: Index Marking Invariant
hints.text: A ')' without a preceding unmatched '(' is unconditionally invalid. Any '(' remaining unmatched at the end of the string is also invalid. All other characters remain in order.

hints.title: Index Collection and Filtering Procedure
hints.text: Maintain an index list for unmatched '(' and an invalid set for unmatched ')'. For each character ch at index i: if ch is '(', record i; if ')', pop from the index list if available, else add i to the invalid set. Add any remaining indices in the list to the invalid set. Reconstruct the string omitting indices in the set.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (1 <= N <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Linear scan to identify invalid indices followed by linear reconstruction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all subsets of bracket removals requires exponential 2^N combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing invalid indices in a set enables O(1) membership check during string reconstruction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing that both excess closing brackets and dangling opening brackets must be identified.
